note: Vector outlines for every land territory and sea zone, extracted from assets/base_map.png's flood-filled regions (see tools/map_geometry.py). Each territory maps to a LIST of polygons (usually one; land island-chain territories and a couple of sea zones with border-art gaps can have several), each a list of [x, y] vertices in reference-image pixel coordinates, closed (no repeated last point). A sea zone polygon is its outer boundary only -- islands it encloses are NOT cut out as holes. Consumers MUST draw/instantiate land territories after (on top of) sea territories so enclosed islands show through correctly.
